reference.author: Carrefour
reference.title: Carrefour is innovating and making available an intuitive tool that enables customers to choose more nutritionally balanced and cheaper food

sources.content_read: PDF pp. 1–3; dated São Paulo, 8 June 2021.

reference.author: Huang, M.-H., & Rust, R. T.
reference.title: A strategic framework for artificial intelligence in marketing
reference.journal: Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science

sources.content_read: Publisher full article; abstract, AI capability framework and limitations/ethical discussion.
sources.claim_and_limit: Mechanical, thinking and feeling AI used in section 2; optimisation bias used in section 4. Online-first date is 2020, but final volume 49(1), pp. 30–50 is 2021. Conceptual theory, not Carrefour field evidence.

reference.author: Majid Al Futtaim
reference.title: Great moments for everyone, everyday: ESG report 2021

sources.content_read: ESG report 2021, printed p. 44; p. 44–45 spread is PDF page 23.
sources.claim_and_limit: Additional 11 UAE Carrefour stores used Tally in the 2021 reporting period. Shelf checks detect missing/misplaced/incorrectly priced products. Sections 1–2 and figure note. Reporting year is not necessarily publication date; no explicit publication date established, so APA n.d. is used and the reporting year remains in the title. No claim of current store coverage.

sources.content_read: Fourth-edition title/copyright pages; course Chapter 8 lecture and supplied restaurant blueprint excerpt, pp. 242–245.
sources.claim_and_limit: Process blueprint, visibility boundaries, customer co-production and redesign applied in sections 3 and 5 and Figure 1. The actual 4th-edition copyright page identifies Jochen Wirtz alone and ©2023. This takes precedence over conflicting course/catalogue author listings. Author-hosted sampler and publisher title page checked; whole textbook was not claimed read.

reference.author: Wirtz, J., Patterson, P. G., Kunz, W. H., Gruber, T., Lu, V. N., Paluch, S., & Martins, A.
reference.title: Brave new world: Service robots in the frontline

sources.content_read: Publisher full article: capabilities, customer perspective and ethical/societal implications.
sources.claim_and_limit: Routine/cognitive versus emotional/social service roles, privacy, safety and employee implications used in sections 2 and 4. All seven authors, year, volume, issue, pages and DOI checked. Conceptual predictions do not prove local acceptance.

APA_checks: Alphabetical order and same-author chronological order checked.
Single-author Wirtz entry before Wirtz and coauthors, irrespective of year.
Sentence case; correct italic journal/volume and standalone titles; hanging indent; DOI canonical URLs.
Every cited source included; no uncited reference.
No source used only on search-snippet evidence.
